meta.name: Free4Techies
meta.tagline: A curated list of free developer tools, services and tiers.

categories.name: Major Cloud Providers
categories.description: Always-free limits from the big three (and friends).

entries.name: Google Cloud Platform
entries.description: App Engine - 28 frontend instance hours per day, Cloud Functions - 2 million invocations/month, Cloud Run - 2 million requests/month, 5GB Cloud Storage, 1TB BigQuery queries/month, and more.

entries.name: Amazon Web Services
entries.description: 1 million Lambda requests/month, 25GB DynamoDB, 1TB CloudFront egress, 100 build minutes on CodeBuild, 10 CloudWatch custom metrics. Full list at aws.amazon.com/free.

entries.name: Microsoft Azure
entries.description: 1 million Functions requests/month, 10 App Service apps, 5GB Blob storage, 25GB Cosmos DB, 10 free parallel Azure Pipelines jobs for open source.

entries.name: Oracle Cloud
entries.description: 2 AMD compute VMs (1/8 OCPU, 1GB), 2 Arm Ampere A1 cores with 12GB memory, 200GB block storage, 10TB egress/month. Always-free, subject to idle reclamation.

entries.name: Cloudflare
entries.description: Free DNS for unlimited domains, CDN + SSL, Workers (100k requests/day), R2 (10GB), D1 (1GB), Pages (500 builds/month), and Tunnel for exposing local ports.

entries.name: GitHub
entries.description: Unlimited public and private repositories with unlimited collaborators. Includes CI/CD (Actions), Codespaces, Pages, Packages, Projects and Copilot.

entries.name: GitLab
entries.description: Unlimited public and private Git repos with up to 5 collaborators. Includes CI/CD, container registry, static hosting and issue tracking.

entries.name: Codeberg
entries.description: Unlimited public and private repos for free and open-source projects with unlimited collaborators. Powered by Forgejo with Codeberg Pages and CI.

entries.name: Bitbucket
entries.description: Unlimited public and private Git repos for up to 5 users with Bitbucket Pipelines for CI/CD.

entries.name: Vercel
entries.description: Host frontend apps and serverless functions. Hobby tier: 100GB bandwidth, 100GB-Hours serverless function execution, unlimited static deployments with automatic HTTPS.

entries.name: Netlify
entries.description: 100GB bandwidth/month, 300 build minutes/month, 125k serverless function calls/month, free automatic HTTPS and deploy previews.

entries.name: Render
entries.description: Free static sites, free web services that sleep after 15 minutes of inactivity, free cron jobs, and free PostgreSQL databases that expire after 90 days.

entries.name: Fly.io
entries.description: Run full apps and databases close to users. Free allowance includes 3 shared-cpu-1x 256MB VMs, 3GB persistent volumes, and 160GB outbound data transfer per month.

entries.name: Railway
entries.description: Infrastructure platform where you can provision databases and deploy apps. Free Trial plan includes $5 of usage credit and 500 execution hours/month.

entries.name: GitHub Actions
entries.description: 2,000 minutes/month free for private repos, unlimited minutes for public repositories. Includes Linux, Windows and ARM runners.

entries.name: CircleCI
entries.description: 6,000 build minutes/month for private projects, unlimited collaborators, 30 parallel jobs. Up to 80,000 free build minutes for open source projects.

entries.name: Buildkite
entries.description: CI pipelines free for 3 users and 5k job minutes/month. Test Analytics developer tier includes 100k test executions/month.

entries.name: Supabase
entries.description: 500MB Postgres database, 1GB storage, 50k monthly active users for auth, 2GB egress, unlimited API requests. Projects pause after 1 week of inactivity.

entries.name: PlanetScale
entries.description: Serverless MySQL platform. Free Scaler plan includes 5GB storage, 1 billion rows read/month, 10 million rows written/month.

entries.name: MongoDB Atlas
entries.description: 512MB M0 shared cluster forever free with full MongoDB features, ideal for development and small production workloads.

entries.name: Neon
entries.description: Serverless Postgres with branching. Free tier includes 1 project, 10 branches, 3GB storage, 100 compute hours/month.

categories.name: Monitoring
categories.description: Uptime, APM and log monitoring with free tiers.

entries.name: UptimeRobot
entries.description: 50 monitors with 5-minute intervals, free status pages, and notifications via email, Slack, Discord and more.

entries.name: Grafana Cloud
entries.description: 10k series for metrics, 50GB logs, 50GB traces, 500 VUh of k6 testing, and unlimited dashboards and alerts forever free.

entries.name: Sentry
entries.description: 5,000 errors/month, 50 performance transactions, 50 replays, and 1 cron monitor for free. Single user.

categories.name: DNS
categories.description: DNS hosting and management with free tiers.

entries.name: Cloudflare DNS
entries.description: Free authoritative DNS for an unlimited number of domains with DDoS protection, unlimited queries, and global anycast.

entries.name: Hurricane Electric Free DNS
entries.description: Free DNS hosting for up to 50 domains with full IPv6 support, dynamic DNS, and slave zone support.

categories.name: Email
categories.description: Email sending, transactional and inbox services.

entries.name: Resend
entries.description: 3,000 emails/month and 100 emails/day free. Developer-friendly API for transactional email with React templates.

entries.name: Brevo (Sendinblue)
entries.description: 300 emails/day free forever with unlimited contacts, marketing automation, and transactional email support.

entries.name: Mailtrap
entries.description: Email testing sandbox with 1,000 test emails/month and a single inbox on the free plan. Safe email capture for dev and staging.

entries.name: Clerk
entries.description: 10,000 monthly active users free with full auth including social, MFA, organizations, and prebuilt React/Next.js components.

entries.name: Auth0
entries.description: 7,000 monthly active users and unlimited logins with social, enterprise and passwordless connections. Includes a custom domain.

entries.name: Logto
entries.description: Open-source auth solution with a free cloud tier of 5,000 monthly active users. Includes social sign-in, MFA and orgs.

categories.name: Design and UI
categories.description: Design assets, icons, fonts and UI kits.

entries.name: Figma
entries.description: Free for individuals: 3 projects, 3 files, unlimited personal files, and real-time collaboration with up to 2 editors per file.

entries.name: Unsplash
entries.description: High-resolution royalty-free photos available for commercial and non-commercial use under the Unsplash license.

entries.name: Lucide Icons
entries.description: Open-source, customizable SVG icon library with 1,500+ icons, free for any use under the ISC license.

categories.name: Generative AI
categories.description: LLM and generative AI services with free tiers.

entries.name: Google AI Studio
entries.description: Free access to Gemini Flash and Gemma models. Free tier offers 5 requests/minute, 20 requests/day, and 250k input tokens/minute.

entries.name: Groq
entries.description: Fast LLM inference for open models like Llama and Mixtral. Free tier with generous rate limits for development and testing.

entries.name: Hugging Face
entries.description: Free tier for hosting models and datasets with up to 30k input characters/month for inference and free Spaces hosting.
